style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 4 Nagala Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: These ribbed glass baubles combine rich color, elegant form, along with skilled craftsmanship in a classic festive accent. Each piece is shaped into a soft, lantern-like silhouette, Drawing influence from vintage decorations found in traditional winter markets. This deep merlot tone offers a warm, refined touch that blends beautifully with both classic and contemporary holiday decor. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade. Dimensions(mm): Height: 80. Width: 80. Depth: 80.
